content:
- name: Enforce third-party actions pinned to commit SHA
  run: |
    violations=$(grep -r 'uses:' .github/workflows --include='*.yml' -h | while IFS= read -r line; do
      line=$(echo "$line" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
      value=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/.*uses:[[:space:]]*//p')
      value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/[[:space:]#].*//')
      [ -z "$value" ] && continue
      if [[ "$value" == *@* ]]; then
        action=$(echo "$value" | cut -d'@' -f1)
        ref=$(echo "$value" | cut -d'@' -f2-)
      else
        echo "$value"
        continue
      fi
      # Skip local actions (paths starting with .)
      if [[ "$action" == ./* ]] || [[ "$action" == './'* ]] || [[ "$action" == '../'* ]]; then
        continue
      fi
      if ! echo "$ref" | grep -iqE '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
        echo "$value"
      fi
    done)
    if [ -n "$violations" ]; then
      echo "Found third-party actions not pinned to commit SHA:"
      echo "$violations"
      exit 1
    else
      echo "All third-party actions are pinned to commit SHA."
    fi
